title: Minimum Semesters to Graduate
statement: There are n courses labeled 1 to n. You are given relations, a list of pairs [a, b] meaning course a must be completed before course b. In each semester you may take any number of courses whose prerequisites have all been completed in previous semesters. Return the minimum number of semesters needed to complete all n courses. If it is impossible to complete all courses due to a cyclic dependency, return -1.
hints: Think of this as a topological sort where all currently-available courses can be done in parallel during the same semester.
Run Kahn's algorithm in layers: each BFS 'wave' of indegree-0 nodes processed together represents one semester.
Track the queue size at the start of each wave, process exactly that many nodes before incrementing the semester count, and if you don't process all n nodes by the time the queue empties, return -1.
